title: Fibonacci String
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: X and Y are strings of lowercase English letters of length between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.; 1 \leq Q \leq 10^5; 1 \leq L_i \leq R_i \leq 10^{18}; C_i is a lowercase English letter.; All given numerical values are integers.
